fps_max.name: FPS Cap
fps_max.description: Caps the maximum rendered frame rate; 0 means uncapped. A stable achievable cap reduces frame time variance and keeps pacing consistent.
fps_max.recommended: 0 (uncapped) or a value steadily above your monitor refresh rate

fps_max_usec.name: FPS Cap (Microseconds)
fps_max_usec.description: Caps the frame interval in microseconds; same purpose as fps_max with higher precision. 0 means uncapped. Ineffective if the current engine build does not expose this command.

mat_queue_mode.name: Material System Thread Mode
mat_queue_mode.description: Controls threading of the material system: -1 engine default, 0 single-threaded synchronous, 1 single-threaded queued, 2 multi-threaded queued. Mode 2 usually improves FPS but can cause rendering glitches or stutters on some systems; test thoroughly after changing.
mat_queue_mode.recommended: 2 for most systems; fall back to -1 if rendering issues appear

threads.name: Host Thread Count
threads.description: Number of threads the engine main loop uses. A bad value can cause stutters, crashes or clearly worse performance; on most modern systems letting the engine manage it is more reliable.
threads.recommended: Leave unset or default; if you must experiment, test step by step

r_createhairpretesselation.name: Hair Pre-Tessellation
r_createhairpretesselation.description: Controls pre-tessellated rendering of character hair. Disabling it removes a small rendering cost with barely visible change.

r_fullscreen_gamma.name: Fullscreen Gamma
r_fullscreen_gamma.description: Adjusts picture gamma in fullscreen mode, directly affecting visibility in dark areas.
r_fullscreen_gamma.recommended: Adjust to your monitor and taste

cl_showfps.name: FPS Display
cl_showfps.description: Shows FPS and other performance debug info in a screen corner; higher values are more verbose. For observation only, no gameplay effect.

showfps_enabled.name: Built-in Performance Display
showfps_enabled.description: The game's built-in performance overlay, showing FPS, frame time graphs and input latency information.

shownet_enabled.name: Network Info Display
shownet_enabled.description: Shows network graphics such as latency and packet loss, useful for diagnosing connection quality.

cl_showpos.name: Position/Velocity Debug Display
cl_showpos.description: Shows current speed, position and orientation as debug data on screen, commonly used while practicing movement.

m_rawinput.name: Raw Input
m_rawinput.description: Makes the game read raw mouse input directly, bypassing OS pointer acceleration and sensitivity. Locked in some game versions; if ineffective it does not affect normal play.

m_filter.name: Mouse Filtering
m_filter.description: Applies smoothing/interpolation to mouse input. Turning it off makes aim tracking feel more direct.

mouse_sensitivity.name: Mouse Sensitivity
mouse_sensitivity.description: In-game mouse sensitivity multiplier; combined with mouse DPI it determines the final feel.

bind.name: Key Binding
bind.description: Binds a key to one command or a chain of commands; one of the most used commands in autoexec and effective immediately. Example: bind F3 exec autoexec.cfg.
bind.recommended: No fixed recommendation; configure to your key layout

exec.name: Execute Config File
exec.description: Reads and executes another cfg file. Commonly exec autoexec.cfg with the +exec launch option to load a personal config, or bound to a key for one-click reload.
exec.recommended: Use with the +exec autoexec launch option

rate.name: Network Bandwidth Cap
rate.description: Maximum bytes per second the client sends to the server. Too low a value may limit updates; raising it beyond need gives no benefit.

cl_updaterate.name: Update Requests Per Second
cl_updaterate.description: Number of world-state update packets requested from the server per second. Apex's actual rate is mostly server-controlled, so the client setting only applies in some cases.
cl_updaterate.recommended: Keep the default unless you know the effect

cl_updaterate_mp.name: Multiplayer Update Rate
cl_updaterate_mp.description: The world-state update rate setting Apex actually uses in multiplayer, similar in purpose to the classic cl_updaterate.
cl_updaterate_mp.recommended: Keep the default; gains from changing it are limited

cl_interp.name: Interpolation Time
cl_interp.description: Buffer time in seconds used to interpolate other players' positions. Too low a value can cause jitter; in many versions this value is enforced by the server.

cl_interp_ratio.name: Interpolation Ratio
cl_interp_ratio.description: Multiplier that derives the interpolation buffer from the update rate. 1 is low buffering, 2 more conservative; changes can affect how hit registration feels.

projectile_prediction.name: Projectile Prediction
projectile_prediction.description: Client-side prediction and compensation for projectile trajectories; affects how your own projectiles appear.

cl_smooth.name: Prediction Error Smoothing
cl_smooth.description: Smooths client prediction errors. Off feels more direct but can jitter; test in-game after changing.
cl_smooth.recommended: Keep 1; try 0 only if chasing maximum responsiveness

mat_vsync.name: V-Sync
mat_vsync.description: Waits for the monitor's vertical sync signal. Disabling it lowers input lag but may cause screen tearing.

mat_antialias.name: Anti-Aliasing Level
mat_antialias.description: Multisample anti-aliasing level; 0 disables it. Higher levels smooth edges more at greater cost.
mat_antialias.recommended: 0 for FPS, 2 to 4 for image quality

mat_forceaniso.name: Anisotropic Filtering
mat_forceaniso.description: Forces an anisotropic filtering level so textures stay sharp at oblique angles; small FPS cost.

mat_picmip.name: Texture Detail
mat_picmip.description: Texture mip bias: 0 highest detail, 4 lowest. Together with stream_memory, lowering detail improves FPS and saves VRAM at the cost of blurrier textures.
mat_picmip.recommended: 4 on low-end systems, 0 to 1 for image quality

stream_memory.name: Texture Streaming Memory
stream_memory.description: Memory budget for texture streaming. Too low a value leaves textures blurry for long stretches; 0 combined with mat_picmip 4 forces the lowest texture detail.
stream_memory.recommended: Keep the default 300000, or 0 for the low-end preset

ssao_enabled.name: Ambient Occlusion
ssao_enabled.description: Screen-space ambient occlusion. Turning it off improves FPS; depth perception is slightly reduced.

r_createmodeldecals.name: Model Decals
r_createmodeldecals.description: Generates bullet holes and similar decals on model surfaces. Turning it off improves FPS stability during firefights.

r_decals.name: Decal Cap
r_decals.description: Cap on decals (bullet holes, marks) kept in the scene at once; lowering it reduces render and memory cost.
r_decals.recommended: 0 or a low value for FPS

r_lod_switch_scale.name: LOD Switch Distance
r_lod_switch_scale.description: Scale for model level-of-detail switch distances. Lower values swap distant models to lower detail earlier: better FPS, coarser distant geometry.
r_lod_switch_scale.recommended: 0.4 to 0.6 on low-end systems, 1.0 for image quality

cl_ragdoll_maxcount.name: Ragdoll Count Cap
cl_ragdoll_maxcount.description: Maximum number of simultaneous ragdolls (death physics). Setting it to 0 disables them and reduces physics cost in fights.

cl_gib_allow.name: Gib Effects
cl_gib_allow.description: Allows flying debris when characters or objects are destroyed. Turning it off reduces the effect load.

particle_cpu_level.name: Particle Effect Level
particle_cpu_level.description: Quality level of CPU-side particle effects. Lowering it reduces performance dips during fights.

mat_postprocess_enable.name: Post-Processing
mat_postprocess_enable.description: Controls HDR and other post effects. Turning it off visibly changes contrast and color grading while improving FPS; compare screenshots before deciding.

r_shadows.name: Shadow Rendering
r_shadows.description: Shadow rendering switch. Setting it to 0 removes most shadows with a clear FPS gain, at the cost of shadow-based information.
r_shadows.recommended: 0 for FPS, 1 if you rely on shadow cues

r_waterdrawreflection.name: Water Reflection
r_waterdrawreflection.description: Renders reflections on water surfaces. Turning it off improves FPS in maps with water; water looks plainer.

snd_mixahead.name: Audio Mix Buffer
snd_mixahead.description: Duration of the sound mixing buffer. Slightly lower values reduce audio latency; too low can cause pops or crackling.

snd_setmixer.name: Per-Channel Volume
snd_setmixer.description: Adjusts the volume of a single audio channel, e.g. snd_setmixer GlobalFootsteps vol 1.2 to boost global footsteps; commonly used to emphasize enemy footsteps over your own.
snd_setmixer.recommended: Fine-tune by ear, e.g. GlobalFootsteps vol 1.2

miles_occlusion.name: Sound Occlusion
miles_occlusion.description: Simulates sound being muffled by walls. Turning it off makes through-wall audio clearer and more direct, but changes the perceived distance of sounds.

cl_fovscale.name: FOV Scale
cl_fovscale.description: Scales the game's field of view; 1.55 is about 110 degrees in-game. Larger values widen the view but increase edge distortion and shrink distant targets.

mat_setvideomode.name: Change Resolution In-Game
mat_setvideomode.description: Switches resolution directly in-game, e.g. mat_setvideomode 1728 1080 0; often combined with bind for quick stretched-resolution switching.
